description: This file defines the FPGMPruner class, a structured sparsifier for filter pruning in neural networks using the geometric median method. It includes methods for initializing the pruner, computing distances between filters, and updating pruning masks based on filter importance.

classes.name: FPGMPruner
classes.description: A structured filter pruning class based on the geometric median method, inheriting from BaseStructuredSparsifier.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the FPGMPruner with a specified sparsity level and distance metric.

methods.name: _compute_distance
methods.description: Computes the distance between filters in a tensor, used to determine filter importance for pruning.

methods.name: update_mask
methods.description: Updates the pruning mask for a given module based on computed filter distances and desired sparsity.
